description: Update a route/page. Wire to controller with both controller and controller_method UUIDs. For significant routes, include context fields. Set meta_title/meta_description (and optional og_* / meta_keywords) to give a public/shared page its own <title> and link-preview text instead of the generic site defaults.

meta_description.description: Meta description and default og/twitter description shown in link previews.

meta_title.description: Page <title> and default og/twitter title. Use for shared/public pages so links preview as this page, not the generic site.

method.description: HTTP method. Use ANY for all methods, MATCH for custom combinations, FALLBACK for 404, REDIRECT/PERMANENT_REDIRECT for redirects.

og_description.description: Open Graph / Twitter description override (defaults to meta_description).

og_image.description: Absolute URL of the Open Graph / Twitter preview image.

og_title.description: Open Graph / Twitter title override (defaults to meta_title).

references.description: Context: Related entities [{uuid, type, relationship, note}]

uuid.description: UUID of the route to update

name: save_route
